Map of the Island of Anjouan, one of the islands of the Comoros from map by Jacque-Nicolas Bellin, featured in "Histoire Générale des Voyages" by Antoine François Prévost.
As reprinted in Joseph Smith, Captain Kidd Lore, and Treasure-Seeking in New York and New England during the Early Republic
